note: libngspice (KiCad 10.0.6, econ-core, 2026-10-31) runs of OUR decks: m0 / m1 the SMBJ5.0CA and S05K11 models at their cited points (.op, board.custom.protection_models.check_deck, esd-6); m2 / m3 the CDM loop (small / large JS-002 module, 500 V) into a short (pcb.custom.esd_events.short_deck, esd-7); the UNO R3 foothold DIGITAL_L:7, the pin alone (board.custom.esd_footholds), baseline / event: fa HBM 2 kV + SMBJ5.0CA, fb HBM 2 kV + S05K11, fc CDM small 500 V bare, fd CDM small 500 V + SMBJ5.0A. Kept: every solver point within 50 us of the event, every 10th elsewhere, the last (the shorts: every point, the meter only); values rounded to 7 significant figures. Reference for esd-6 / esd-7.

fa0.deck:
* esd-5: hbm at 0 V on foothold DIGITAL_L:7 of datasheet/arduino-uno-r3 - the pin alone (board.custom.esd_footholds)
* the pin held at 5 V (logic_volts) through hold_ohm 1e+06; pin_cap_pf 10 (knobs on the area)
Vhold esd_hold 0 DC 5
Rhold esd_hold pin 1e+06
Cpin pin 0 10p
* esd-1: hbm at 0 V into pin at 1e-06 s (pcb.custom.esd_events)
Vesdchg esd_chg 0 DC 0
Resdchg esd_chg esd_k 1
Sesdchg esd_k esd_c esd_off 0 esdsw
Cesd esd_c 0 1e-10
Sesddis esd_c esd_r esd_on 0 esdsw
Resd esd_r esd_m 1500
Vesdmeas esd_m pin DC 0
Vesdon esd_on 0 PULSE(0 1 1e-06 1n 1n 1 2)
Vesdoff esd_off 0 PULSE(1 0 1e-06 1n 1n 1 2)
.model esdsw sw vt=0.5 vh=0 ron=0.01 roff=1e12
* esd-3: protection part smbj5.0ca (board.custom.protection_parts)
Vprotm1 pin esd_p1 DC 0
Dprot1a 0 esd_q1 esdp_smbj5_0ca
Dprot1b esd_p1 esd_q1 esdp_smbj5_0ca
.model esdp_smbj5_0ca D(IS=1e-14 N=1 RS=0.00683381 BV=6.28519 IBV=0.01 NBV=1)
.options method=gear
.tran 10n 3.1e-05
.end
